parts.name: shaft_cap
parts.supports: Approved taller cap: X-4.8 inner wall, 2.6 mm slot end ligaments. Single X12 outer face down (+90 degrees about Y), including body, rail wings and all four screw seats; 4.2 mm rail thickness. Slicer/support review still required; no support-free claim.

parts.name: carrier
parts.supports: Approved flat X-5.8 collar underside down (CAD Y+90), lower hook ramp; matches final PETG plate. Approved upright orientation; 6 mm arm/tongue slot with 35-degree roof. Matched PETG 0.12 mm automatic-support slice adds no support geometry; existing supports remain. See 2026-10-25-jaw-arm-slots. Physical roof quality, sliding fit and loaded strength unverified.

parts.name: sliding_jaw
parts.supports: Two 31 x 4 mm beam windows leave 3.8 mm edge rails; tongue slot and central/stud islands retained. Fresh slice required. Continuous beam and root share X-10 rear bed face (CAD Y-90) and X-2 front face. Beam/studs shift5.2 mm; assembly slides outward5.2 mm to preserve cuff contacts. See flush-beam PETG slice; physical strength, engagement and band preload unverified.

parts.name: phone_cuff
parts.supports: Common 21.6 mm TPU cuff, back down. User reports tiny first-layer supports unnecessary; cuff batch disables support. Not a complete-jaw qualification.

parts.name: actuator_bracket
parts.supports: Common flat Y5.4 back face down (-90 degrees about X). Outer pulley cheek/arm and raised plinth removed; remaining boss raised 2 mm. Extended curved guide and independent return stop. Fresh slice required; support savings and cantilever strength unqualified.

parts.name: plunger

parts.name: pulley
